thread:
Maya: Quick status check on caching + batching rollout for optimize-toolkit. Who owns the canary and who's blocked? Noticing perf regressions in staging on long-sequence (>4k) requests. @Sam @Julia please advise.
Sam: I can own the canary. I saw a tail-latency spike in staging after the int8 profile landed — looks like KV cache miss rate climbed on very long sessions.
Julia: We turned on `quant_profile: int8_fast` in canary yesterday. Short sequences saw ~18-20% throughput uplift, but for traces >4096 tokens the cache eviction pattern changed and misses increased.
Ben: Putting the PR here: https://github.com/redwood/optimize-toolkit/pull/438 — contains the quant + batching config and the perf dashboard link. cc @Ravi for infra implications.
Ravi: Autoscaler cooldown is still set to 120s which delays adding nodes for bursty long requests. I'll open infra ticket to adjust policy and bump max nodes for the canary.
Sam: Suggest we pause the canary rollback of the quant flag until we confirm KV-fix. Quick config snapshot I'm testing:
```yaml
quant_profile: "int8_fast"
batching:
  max_tokens: 1024
  max_batch: 16
  timeout_ms: 25
cache:
  prefix_cache: true
  eviction_policy: lru
  ttl_ms: 600000
```
Sam: The spike appears when multiple long sequences compete and eviction churn causes extra KV recompute.
Julia: I have a KV cache eviction fix in PR 441 (https://github.com/redwood/optimize-toolkit/pull/441) — addresses the churn and adds a small async write buffer. Tests for seq>4096 are failing right now but the patch reduces misses in local repro.
Ben: :thumbsup: I'll tag the rollout as `paused` and stop further traffic increases. Who can validate after PR 441 merges?
Sam: I can run the perf suite tomorrow morning (06:30 PT) and validate tail-latency and throughput across seq buckets. Please don't unpause canary until I post results.
Maya: I'll notify support and sales (brief note + impact matrix) and add a release-note blurb that we're blocking int8 on long-seq workloads until KV fix. Also adding monitor: tail-latency > 2000ms -> pager.
deploy-bot: Canary paused by @Ben — rollout halted at 10% traffic.
Ravi: Filed infra ticket INF-1123 to reduce cooldown to 30s for canary pool and temporarily increase max nodes. Linking to PRs and perf runs.
Ben: Assignment recap: Sam = perf validation, Julia = PR 441 review + tests, Ravi = autoscaler tweak, Maya = comms & release notes. ETA for next check-in: tomorrow EOD PT.
Julia: Quick FYI: short-seq benchmarks remain solid — embedding cost down ~18% with int8. So this is a targeted regression, not a general perf loss.
Maya: Thanks team — will follow up once Sam posts the perf results. If anything blocks PR 441 review, ping here and I'll escalate. :raised_hands:
